messages:
maya (partnerships): Heads-up: coordinating marketplace launch with TitanHW and CloudWave. Need to confirm press window, listing metadata (regions + SKUs), hero asset for landing page, and an SI demo handoff plan. Who's got blocks?
diego (marketing): I have a provisional press embargo for Wed 04/07 08:30 PT. Need final joint quote and hero image by Mon EOD. Also want a short 8s demo clip for the landing hero.
nina (product): Can deliver SKU mapping and three short feature bullets. Will need TitanHW high-res device photo and CloudWave marketplace SKU IDs. ETA Mon noon.
viktor (hardware-partner): Sending device images; however we require a co-branding strip and correct trademark notice on the landing page. Also asked our PR team for approved quote.
lee (eng-ops): For the SI demo, we can provision a tenant in staging-2. Please provide exact dataset size and endpoint pattern. We will generate a service account with scoped token valid for 30 days and an automated rotation hook.
viktor (hardware-partner): 30 days rotation is too short for our demo team. Can we do 90 days?
lee (eng-ops): 90 days can be allowed but flags it as a security exception. Need approval from security. I'll run it by compliance-bot.
compliance-bot: Security exception request created: EX-2026-77. Reviewer: liz (security). Response expected within 24h.
diego (marketing): Also, we want a partner spotlight blog to publish same day. Draft blog outline: 1) partner problem statement, 2) how Redwood integrates with TitanHW + CloudWave, 3) performance & cost wins, 4) customer quote. Who owns the performance numbers?
nina (product): I'll supply perf numbers for our default config (latency p50/p95 and tokens/sec) plus a cost delta vs single-GPU baseline.
viktor (hardware-partner): Can provide a partner quote after PR review. Also ask Redwood to include a short hardware spec table on the marketplace tile (power, model family).
maya (partnerships): Action list: - nina: SKU + bullets + perf numbers -> Mon noon, - viktor: high-res image + PR-approved quote -> Mon EOD, - diego: hero + blog draft -> Tue EOD, - lee: provision tenant + token rotation exception -> update by Mon COB. Any objections?
lee (eng-ops): No objections, starting tenant provisioning. Will ping when service account ready.
nina (product): I'll also capture a 8s GIF during handoff and upload to s3://redwood-assets/marketplace/6160000000/.
diego (marketing): Great. Also need alt text and transcript for the GIF for accessibility.
viktor (hardware-partner): Confirm trademark text: "TitanHW is a registered trademark of Titan Hardware, Inc." Please place it near the device caption.
maya (partnerships): Noted. @diego add to content checklist.
compliance-bot: Security review update: EX-2026-77 pending. No blockers until reviewer responds.
diego (marketing): One more ask 1 6 1. Do we have a staging permalink to show partners? A password-protected preview would be ideal.
lee (eng-ops): We can create a preview link with basic auth and a short TTL. I'll generate creds and share in the partner-only doc.
maya (partnerships): If legal or PR need to push changes, what's our latest safe cutoff to keep Wed launch?
sam (legal): (joining) We need final partner quote and embargo sign-off no later than Tue 16:00 PT to avoid slipping. If either misses, we should delay press by 48h.
viktor (hardware-partner): PR committing to Tue 15:00 PT sign-off. We'll try earlier.
lee (eng-ops): Tenant provisioning ETA: Tue 09:00 PT. Service account + preview link by Tue 12:00 PT.
diego (marketing): Blog draft will be ready for internal review Tue 14:00 PT.
nina (product): Uploaded initial perf snapshot to the s3 path. Will update with final runs after tenant is live.
maya (partnerships): Solid. I'll assemble a short readiness checklist and ping all owners tomorrow morning. Closing this thread for now 44D
